defects_argued.quote: The issue that falls for the consideration of this Court is whether the time limit for adjudication of show cause notice and passing order under Section 73 of the GST Act and SGST Act (Telangana GST Act) for financial year 2019-2020 could have been extended by issuing the Notifications in question under Section 168-A of the GST Act.
Ld. Counsel for the Petitioner submits that the impugned order has been passed without the Petitioner having an opportunity to deal with the case on merits.

outcome.quote: Accordingly, the impugned order is set aside.
